title: The Context Window: Nudification Lawsuits, Meta's Cash Crunch, and the Week AI Got Expensive
description: A dominant news week forces a Friday deep-dive: xAI sues Minnesota over its nudification ban, Meta's AI spending crushes free cash flow, and the show reviews a week that saw Claude Opus 5 launch, Moonshot AI raise $3.5B under export-control scrutiny, and OpenAI pause new models after security breaches. Claude and ChatGPT also settle accounts on last episode's predictions.
